title: BMW's new i3 50 xDrive (Neue Klasse electric 3 Series sedan) drove 5,886.7 km from North Cape, Norway, to Tarifa, Spain, across eight countries with 2 h 45 min 54 s of total charging on public chargers (BMW Group, 10 Nov 2026): 275 kW average charging, 400 kW peak, 12.5 kWh/100 km, 3 d 2 h 41 min driving, one engineer; BMW says it beat the 2017 record by 7+ hours (not independently timed); i3 not confirmed for India, iX3 LWB due in India in 2027
